description: This file defines the DashboardController class which manages the dashboard view in the OrangeHRM web application. It extends an abstract Vue.js controller and incorporates traits for authentication, service management, and user role management. The preRender method prepares data, permissions, and view components before rendering the dashboard page.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard page rendering and permissions in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares component setup and user permissions data before rendering the dashboard view.
